
# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 - Architecture and Setup

## Project Overview
Next.js 16+ App Router application with React 19.2+, TypeScript 5.5+, and Tailwind CSS v4 using the OKLCH color space.

## Architecture Guidelines
- Strict adherence to zero-new-routes invariant.
- All modifications are scoped within existing components and pages.
- Focus on content expansion, semantic structure, performance, and interactivity without altering the underlying infrastructure topology.
- CSS styling focuses on a light glassmorphism aesthetic and a strict spatial rhythm.

## Blueprint Summary
For full architectural details, consult the `.jules/revolution-plan.json` and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` files generated by the Auditor-Architect agent.
